'''Archies Limited''' (earlier called '''Archies Greetings and Gifts Ltd''') is an Indian multinational retailer of [[greeting cards]] and [[gifts]], based in [[New Delhi]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.archiesonline.com/gateway/contact_archies.php |title=Contact|Send Fresh Flowers To India|Buy Fresh Flowers|Rose|Bunches|Business Queries |publisher=Archiesonline.com |accessdate=7 August 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100211100606/http://www.archiesonline.com/gateway/contact_archies.php |archive-date=11 February 2010 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== History ==
Founded in 1979 by Anil Moolchandani, the company initially sold song books, [[posters]] and leather patches. The company's main product, greeting cards, was introduced in 1980. Cards were introduced for major [[Indian festivals]] such as [[Holi]], [[Diwali]] and [[Raksha Bandhan|Rakhi]], apart from the usual new year, birthday and anniversary occasions. The company went public in 1995. In 1998, it was listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]].

Archies Limited is in the business of manufacturing and selling [[greeting card]]s and other social expression products such as gifts and posters. Archies has a market share of about 50% of India's greeting cards market.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/news-by-industry/et-cetera/Archies-captures-half-of-Indias-greeting-cards-market/articleshow/2663572.cms |title=Archies captures half of India's greeting cards market|work=The Economic Times|date=31 December 2007 |accessdate=7 August 2010}}</ref>

== Outlets and Stores ==
Archies has about 250+ franchise and 230+ exclusive outlets, called Archies Galleries, spread across 120 cities<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.archiesonline.com/gateway/archies_superbrand_article.php |title=Archies Superbrand Article |publisher=Archiesonline.com |accessdate=7 August 2010 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100621064904/http://www.archiesonline.com/gateway/archies_superbrand_article.php |archivedate=21 June 2010 }}</ref> and 6 countries. It has tie-ups and licensing arrangements for merchandising characters such as [[Dennis the Menace (U.S.)|Dennis the Menace]] and Disney characters. It has arrangements with Paramount Cards Inc., [[Anne Geddes]], and [[American Greetings]], for greeting card design and name use.

== Expansion ==
Following the increasing popularity of [[e-card]]s, Archies started its [[online portal]] in 2000.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.icmrindia.org/casestudies/catalogue/Business%20Strategy1/Archies%20The%20Way%20Indians%20Greet.htm |title=Archies: The Way Indians Greet | Business Strategy Case Studies | Case Study in Business, Management |publisher=Icmrindia.org |accessdate=7 August 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.all-science-fair-projects.com/science_fair_projects_encyclopedia/Archies_Limited |title=Science Fair Projects - Archies Limited |publisher=All-science-fair-projects.com |accessdate=7 August 2010 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110726113831/http://www.all-science-fair-projects.com/science_fair_projects_encyclopedia/Archies_Limited |archivedate=26 July 2011 }}</ref> The company expanded its product range to include artificial jewelry, crystal ware, [[chocolate]]s and [[perfume]]s, and accordingly changed its name to Archies Limited in 2002.
